forums: jurisdictional Special Court or trial court

remedies: regular bail addressing the Section 43D(5) prima-facie filter where it applies

deadline_rules: For the Section 43D investigation-period lane, calculate the statutory timeline from the actual remand record and verify any Public Prosecutor report and court extension order before claiming default bail.
Long custody alone does not satisfy or displace the Section 43D(5) prima-facie test; any constitutional delay argument requires a separately registered and verified current precedent.
documents: arrest and first-remand dates with remand orders
Public Prosecutor extension report and Special Court order if any
prior bail rejection order and the prosecution material relied on for prima-facie findings
escalation: identify whether the immediate issue is regular bail or default bail
obtain the complete remand and extension record before calculating a default-bail deadline
use Special Court or High Court counsel and DLSA support for the fact-specific application
